title: Claude Code plugin default settings
description: A plugin's root settings.json, or the manifest's settings object, as Claude Code 2.1.321 reads it (Agent Plugins Extended 1.1.0, section 12.6). Only agent and subagentStatusLine take effect; every other key is dropped at load without an error, so it is accepted here.
$comment: Every key but agent and subagentStatusLine is dropped at load, and so is a value of the wrong type for one of the two, or a file that is not an object; none of it stops the plugin (section 12.6 item 1, Judgment J12.10). So the root accepts any JSON value, and $defs/effective states the values that take effect.

agent.description: One of the plugin's own agents, run as the main thread (section 12.6 item 5).
